verses.text: All who are slaves should treat their masters as worthy of full respect. Then no one will speak against God's name and our teaching.

Slaves whose masters are believers should not respect them less because they are brothers. Instead, they should serve them even better, because those who benefit from their work are believers whom they love. Teach these things and urge people to do them.
Someone may teach different ideas and not agree with the true and healthy words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the teaching that leads to living for God.
That person is proud and understands nothing. He has an unhealthy love of arguing and fighting about words. This leads to jealousy, quarrels, insults, evil suspicions,
and constant fights between people whose minds are rotten and who have lost hold of the truth. They think that serving God is a way to get rich. Keep away from such people.
But living for God, and being content with what you have, is a great gain.
We brought nothing into the world, and we certainly cannot take anything out of it.
So if we have food and clothes, we will be content with that.
People who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap. They fall into many foolish and harmful desires that drag people down to ruin and destruction.
For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered away from the faith and stabbed themselves with many sorrows.
But you, man of God, run away from all this. Chase after what is right, living for God, faith, love, patience and gentleness.
Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the life that lasts for ever. God called you to it when you spoke up well about your faith in front of many witnesses.
In front of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who spoke up well when he stood before Pontius Pilate, I command you:
keep this command without stain or fault until our Lord Jesus Christ appears.
God will make that happen at the right time. He is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
He alone can never die. He lives in light that no one can come near. No one has ever seen him, and no one can see him. To him be honour and power for ever. Amen.

Command those who are rich in this world not to be proud. Tell them not to put their hope in riches, which are so uncertain. They should put their hope in the living God, who richly gives us everything to enjoy.
Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.
In this way they will store up treasure for themselves, a strong base for the time to come. Then they will take hold of the life that is truly life for ever.
Timothy, guard what has been trusted to you. Turn away from godless empty talk, and from the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge.
Some people have claimed to have this knowledge, and so they have wandered away from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
